Discuss this statement, using appropriate examples to explain your answer.

ENVR07036 — Energy and Sustainability

Based on 4 exam papers: June 22/23, August 22/23, June 23/24, August 23/24

Click any topic to expand notes.

Calculate the U-value for a multi-layer building element. Surface resistances (Rsi=0.13, Rso=0.04) included automatically.

Layer details
Combined U-value
—
Formula: U = 1 / (0.13 + Σ(d/λ) + 0.04)  |  d in metres
Common λ values (W/mK)
Polyurethane: 0.025
Phenolic board: 0.022
Polystyrene EPS: 0.038
Bead insulation: 0.022
Plasterboard: 0.18
Concrete block: 0.11–0.22
Aerated block: 0.095
Slate on battens: 0.22
Sand/cement render: 0.12
